english.note: A speaker uses this when emphasizing the dead or gruesome nature of the body.

exampleSentences.english: I screamed when I opened the door and saw a gruesome corpse.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我一開門就見到一具血淋淋嘅死屍，嚇到喊出聲。
